definitions.extremes: A: maximum mean Brown contrast; B/C: maximum/minimum mean GPT-2 contrast. Selected to illustrate diagnostic extremes, not typical outputs.
definitions.fragments: Number of distinct texts containing each lowercase ASCII-word trigram; one vote per text. Six most frequent, ties alphabetically. Trigrams may overlap.
definitions.groups: Post-hoc grouping by the previously noted phrase one poem association. Equal weight per distinct text after averaging duplicate records; descriptive, without causal attribution.
definitions.ranges: One row per selected record, showing min/max and interquartile range of candidate-minus-each-shuffle GPT-2 scores, plus their mean. There are 32 shuffles per row. These are permutation spreads, not confidence intervals.
definitions.scatter: One point per exact surface text; each contrast is averaged across its saved records, with equal weight per record.
